observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Indoor concert venue, likely a punk rock show.
observation.dancers: Large group, mixed gender, mostly young adults.
observation.formation_and_space: Crowd in a mosh pit, moving chaotically in a dense, shifting group.
observation.posture: Torso is upright or slightly hunched, knees are bent to facilitate jumping.
observation.footwork: Vertical jumping on the beat, landing on both feet, often with knees bent.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms are often raised, flailing, or used to push others in the crowd.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso moves vertically with the jumps; some swaying and pushing.
observation.partnering: None; physical contact is incidental, involving pushing and shoving within the crowd.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Frequent vertical jumps; some individuals are lifted or crowd-surf.
observation.costume_and_props: Casual punk attire: jeans, t-shirts, leather jackets, some with mohawks.
observation.cannot_infer: The fast-paced movement and low-resolution video make it difficult to see precise footwork or individual weight transfers.

signature_moments.what: The dancers perform a pogo jump, which involves jumping vertically with both feet while keeping the torso relatively upright.
Dancers in the crowd jump repeatedly in place, often pushing against each other.
A dancer is lifted above the crowd while others continue to pogo jump below.
Dancers jump in unison with the fast tempo of the music.
A dancer is lifted and crowd-surfs while the rest of the group continues to jump.
Dancers jump and push in a dense, chaotic group formation.
